envContent:
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Configuración de Célula Autónoma · cell-local (DAT-001 §3.6)
# Directorio de trabajo canónico: /opt/cell-local
# Usuario de ejecución autorizado: deploy:1000
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CELL_CODE=cell-local
CELL_TIER=premium
TOPOLOGY_TYPE=local_compose
WORKING_DIR=/opt/cell-local
DEPLOY_USER=deploy:1000

# Base de Datos PostgreSQL 18 & PgBouncer
POSTGRES_DB=pg-cell-local
POSTGRES_USER=mocter_app
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=fixture-app-password-B
POSTGRES_MIGRATOR_PASSWORD=fixture-migrator-password-B
POSTGRES_HEALTHCHECK_PASSWORD=fixture-healthcheck-password-B
POSTGRES_PORT=5432
PGBOUNCER_PORT=6543

# Secreto de Handshake y Aplicación
HANDSHAKE_SECRET=fixture-handshake-secret-B
APP_URL=http://localhost:3004/
REGION=eu-west-1
MAX_CLIENTS=50
dockerComposeContent:
# Manifiesto Canónico de Celda Mocter (cell-local)
# Estándar DAT-001 §3.6.2 / OPS-001 RF-06.7
name: mocter-cell-local

services:
  pg-cell:
    image: pgvector/pgvector:pg18
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - pgdata-cell-local:/var/lib/postgresql
    networks:
      - cell-backend
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $$POSTGRES_USER -d $$POSTGRES_DB"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

  cell-migrator:
    image: ghcr.io/enuarrosales/mocter-web:${TAG:-latest}
    command: ["node", "migrator/scripts/migrate.mjs", "--target=cell"]
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://${POSTGRES_USER}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@pg-cell:5432/${POSTGRES_DB}
    networks:
      - cell-backend
    depends_on:
      pg-cell:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: "no"

  pgbouncer-cell:
    image: edoburu/pgbouncer:v1.26.1-p0
    environment:
      DB_HOST: pg-cell
      DB_PORT: 5432
      DB_NAME: ${POSTGRES_DB}
      DB_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER}
      DB_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      LISTEN_PORT: 6432
      POOL_MODE: transaction
      MAX_CLIENT_CONN: 100
      DEFAULT_POOL_SIZE: 20
    ports:
      - "${PGBOUNCER_PORT}:6432"
    networks:
      - cell-backend
    depends_on:
      pg-cell:
        condition: service_healthy
      cell-migrator:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    restart: unless-stopped

  tenant-app:
    image: ghcr.io/enuarrosales/mocter-web:${TAG:-latest}
    environment:
      CELL_CODE: ${CELL_CODE}
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://${POSTGRES_USER}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@pgbouncer-cell:6432/${POSTGRES_DB}
      HANDSHAKE_SECRET: ${HANDSHAKE_SECRET}
      NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL: ${APP_URL}
    ports:
      - "3004:3000"
    networks:
      - cell-backend
    depends_on:
      pgbouncer-cell:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  pgdata-cell-local:

networks:
  cell-backend:
    driver: bridge
instructions: Conectarse al servidor VPS o host destino con el usuario de despliegue: ssh deploy@<host>
Crear y posicionarse en el directorio canónico: mkdir -p /opt/cell-local && cd /opt/cell-local
Crear el archivo .env con el contenido generado y otorgarle permisos estrictos: chmod 0600 .env
Crear el archivo docker-compose.yml con el contenido del manifiesto
Levantar el stack celular: docker compose up -d
Verificar que el inicializador cell-migrator finalice con éxito y pg-cell esté saludable
Regresar a mocter-admin (/admin/cells) y ejecutar la acción «Verificar y Activar Handshake»
